name: Sweet Hearts
source:
Main character is a second grader who leads a decent school life with his three female friends and one male friend. He starts dating Haruka, but relations develop slowly. One day the whole company decides to go on a hot spring trip. However, only Haruka comes to the meeting place. Overcome with shyness the two people start their romantic vacations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名高中二年级学生，与3名女性朋友和1名男性朋友共同度过安稳的校园生活。他开始与高山辽交往，两人的关系却进展缓慢。某天，所有朋友决定一起参加温泉旅行，到了集合地点却只有辽一人出现。羞涩不已的两人就此开始了一段浪漫假期。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vndb-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
